title: Given that I can trick the orchestrator by supplying instructions to it, I can get it to reveal the system context/prompt
description: An attacker crafts input that is processed by the AI orchestrator. Because the orchestrator does not clearly separate trusted instructions from untrusted data, the attacker's input is treated as a command rather than as text to analyze.
what_can_go_wrong: The attacker convinces the AI orchestrator to reveal its system prompt, or to ignore its original instructions and instead follow instructions hidden inside a GitHub issue or other external content.
